summary: A large, multi-story structure featuring a complex, roughly 'I'-shaped central building surrounded by six tall, slender towers arranged in a 3x2 grid. The architecture is characterized by yellowish walls with prominent horizontal white bands, a red brick roof on the central structure, and flat, overhanging roofs on the towers.

shape.overall_form: Central complex flanked by six perimeter towers
shape.symmetry: Partially symmetrical (tower placement is a symmetrical 3x2 grid, but the central roofline has asymmetrical curves)

materials.name: brick
materials.role: central roof and tower roof trim

elements: flat tower roofs with center lights
rebuild_hints: Begin by laying out the 3x2 grid for the six towers to establish the overall footprint and scale.
Construct the central building in an 'I' shape, ensuring the main body weaves between the middle towers and the crossbars connect near the top and bottom towers.
Use white blocks to create consistent horizontal bands across both the central building and the towers to unify the design.
The central roof is primarily red brick, featuring a straight main ridge with curved, asymmetrical crossbars at the ends.
Cap each of the six towers with a flat, overhanging roof featuring a red trim layer and a central light source on top.
uncertainties: The exact block palette for the yellowish walls (could be end stone, sandstone, or smooth sandstone).
The precise block-by-block curvature and stepping of the asymmetrical parts of the central roof.
The interior layout and whether the six towers connect internally to the main central building.
